Homeopathic & Herbal Remedies.productName: Hemani Shifa Oil 100mL, Natural Herbal Massage Oil Blend, External Use, Halal
Homeopathic & Herbal Remedies.shortDescription: Hemani Shifa Oil is a traditional herbal massage oil blend made with olive oil, black seed oil, peppermint oil, Commiphora wightii (guggul) oil, sesame oil, camphor oil and eucalyptus oil. It is a lightweight oil for external use: apply a small amount to the skin and massage gently until absorbed. Made by Hemani, a family herbal house since 1949. Halal certified and alcohol-free. 100 mL (3.38 fl oz) bottle in a printed carton. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place.
